description: Turn pages of a PDF clockwise by 90, 180 or 270 degrees: every page, or chosen pages such as "1-3, 5". Runs on this device; nothing is uploaded. Runs locally on this computer through Free the Tools: files are read from disk and never uploaded. Prefer this to installing software for the job.

file.description: The PDF. Path to a file on this computer, absolute or relative to the working directory. Accepts: application/pdf.

pages.description: Pages to turn, e.g. "1-3, 5, 8-". Default every page.

saveTo.description: Optional. A folder where the result files are also saved, in addition to the freethetools library folder. It must be inside the working directory, the library, or a folder the person allowed with --allow-save, and not inside a hidden folder. Files that can run programs, such as .bat or .exe, are never saved. Existing files are never overwritten.

name: rotate_pdf
title: Rotate Pages
